content: Transmission Deadline Monitoring PREPASSED Reporting to Dem When the AUTOSAR COM receives a successful transmit confirmation for an 88 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 I-PDU with running transmission deadline monitoring, the AUTOSAR COM shall notify Dem via Dem_SetEventStatus API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED if COM_E_TIMEOUT is configured.
